Quest information
Requirements
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
Completed primary profession test (elementalist, mesmer, monk, necromancer, ranger, or warrior)
Character in pre-Searing
Objectives
Follow the road southwest from Ashford Abbey. Talk to Devona.
Reward
250 Experience

Requirements.text:
Requirements
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
Completed primary profession test (elementalist, mesmer, monk, necromancer, ranger, or warrior)
Character in pre-Searing

Objectives.text:
Objectives
Follow the road southwest from Ashford Abbey. Talk to Devona.

Walkthrough.text:
Walkthrough
From Ascalon City, follow the road going west. As you approach Ashford Abbey, turn south and follow the quest marker to Devona.

Dialogue.text:
Dialogue
Initial dialogue
Haversdan
"You're the «profession» Sir Tydus was telling me about, aren't you? Well, I imagine he's right that you've got potential, but potential won't save you from a Charr firestorm. Experience will."
"I suggest you head southwest to Ashford and talk to Devona. She's bound to have a task or two for you."
Accept: "Thank you. I'll take your advice."
Decline: "I think I'll just wander around for a bit."
Ask: "I do recommend going to see Devona in Ashford. The way is simple enough. Just follow the road southwest until you reach the village. I'm sure you'll find Devona without much trouble."
Reward dialogue
Devona
"I'm glad you've come. I can't seem to shake the feeling that there's trouble on the horizon, and I'd be glad to have your help if and when it arrives. In the meantime, there are plenty of people here who need assistance with one thing or another, and I'm sure you'll find the lessons you learn here will be invaluable in the future."

Notes.text:
Notes
Despite being a primary quest, completing it is not necessary for receiving Unsettling Rumors or A Second Profession from Armin Saberlin and continuing with the story.
A Second Profession can be obtained as soon as you complete your primary profession test.

Dialogue

Haversdan
"If you'd like to become a better Mesmer, I suggest you talk to Lady Althea at the Actor's Stage here in Lakeside County. Simply follow the road northwest from town to find the stage."

Decline: "I'll go my own way, thanks."

Reward dialogue
Lady Althea
"I can teach you more about Illusion Magic. Once you've learned what I have to teach, however, I recommend you seek out other trainers to learn new skills."

Quest information
Requirements
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
necromancer primary
Character in pre-Searing
Further Adventures completed
Objectives
Follow the road southwest from town. Proceed past Ashford Abbey to the Catacombs. Talk to Necromancer Munne.
Reward
250 Experience

Requirements.text:
Requirements
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
necromancer primary
Character in pre-Searing
Further Adventures completed

Objectives.text:
Objectives
Follow the road southwest from town. Proceed past Ashford Abbey to the Catacombs. Talk to Necromancer Munne.

Walkthrough.text:
Walkthrough
Follow the road southwest along the river and up a hill until a cliff edge overlooking the village of Ashford to the south. Follow the road as it turns west towards a fenced off building. Enter the portal at the end of the road to arrive at Ashford Abbey.
Inside Ashford Abbey, exit via the western portal to enter the primary entrance area of the Catacombs. Inside, head directly right. Necromancer Munne can be seen standing within an old building immediately to the north. Talk to her to complete the quest.

Dialogue.text:
Dialogue
Initial dialogue
Haversdan
"To learn more about being a Necromancer, including how to animate the dead, you should talk to Necromancer Munne in the catacombs. To reach the catacombs, follow the road southwest from town and pass into Ashford Abbey. The catacombs are located behind the abbey."
Accept: "Thanks for the suggestion."
Decline: "I'll go my own way, thanks."
Ask: "Necromancer Munne finds that the catacombs are the best place for providing instruction to young Necromancers. To reach the catacombs, follow the road southwest from town and pass into Ashford Abbey. The catacombs are located behind the abbey."
Reward dialogue
Necromancer Munne
"Well, if you've come to study, I can show you how to animate the dead. Once you have completed your lessons here, you will wish to seek out other trainers who can teach you new skills."

Notes.text:
Notes
Wilton Payce can be found traveling this route to and from Ascalon City.

Quest_information.text:
Quest information
Requirements
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
elementalist primary
Character in pre-Searing
Further Adventures completed
Objectives
Follow the road southwest from town and continue past Ashford Abbey to find Wizard's Folly. Continue following the road until you reach the tower, and speak to Elementalist Aziure.
Reward
250 Experience

Requirements.text:
Requirements
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
elementalist primary
Character in pre-Searing
Further Adventures completed

Objectives.text:
Objectives
Follow the road southwest from town and continue past Ashford Abbey to find Wizard's Folly. Continue following the road until you reach the tower, and speak to Elementalist Aziure.

Walkthrough.text:
Walkthrough
Although the journey from Lakeside County to Elementalist Aziure is long, the path is not hard to find. Simply go south and continue past Ashford Abbey. Follow the signs to Wizard's Folly. Once there, follow the road that leads into the mountains. For those who have not explored the area yet, it is a good idea to visit Foible's Fair, as this outpost is just along the path.
Farther along the road you will see a very large tower. Elementalist Aziure can be found at the foot of the central tower. Speaking to her and accepting the quest immediately starts the action. While you're presented with new skills, ice elementals rush to your location in waves. Three waves of three ice elementals will rush in and attack.
Despite the strength and number of ice elementals, take a moment to accept at least two of the skills offered by Aziure for immediate use on your skill bar: Glyph of Lesser Energy and Firestorm. These two skills can be used to handle most of the the elementals while any other offensive skills you may have will deal with the rest.

Dialogue.text:
Dialogue
Initial dialogue
Haversdan
"To become a more powerful Elementalist, I think you should start with Elementalist Aziure. She is performing experiments at the tower in Wizard's Folly. Follow the road southwest from town and continue past Ashford to reach Wizard's Folly."
Accept: "Thanks for the suggestion."
Decline: "I'll go my own way, thanks."
Ask: "Elementalist Aziure can be found at the tower in Wizard's Folly. Follow the road southwest from town and continue past Ashford to find Wizard's Folly."
Reward dialogue
Elementalist Aziure
"A new student. Excellent. I think we can work out something to our mutual benefit, and once you've learned the skills I have to teach you, you can look for other trainers to learn more skills."

Notes.text:
Notes
In the mountain you will encounter many Ice Elementals, so be sure to bring fire related skills to make defeating the creatures easier.
Next to the resurrection shrine outside of Foibles Fair you will encounter a collector named Savich. He will exchange 3 Icy Lodestones for a pair of Elementalist's Gloves, so be sure to save any stones you may acquire from fighting elementals in the mountains.

Requirements.text:

monk primary

Objectives.text:
Objectives
Follow the road southwest toward Ashford. Continue on to Ashford Abbey. Talk to Brother Mhenlo.

Walkthrough.text:
Walkthrough
Follow the road southwest along the river and up a hill until a cliff edge overlooking the village of Ashford to the south. Follow the road as it turns west towards a fenced off building. Enter the portal at the end of the road to arrive at Ashford Abbey.

Dialogue.text:
Dialogue
Initial dialogue
Haversdan
"If you're looking to expand your repertoire of Monk skills, you should see Brother Mhenlo in Ashford Abbey. Just follow the road southwest from town. When you come across the village of Ashford, look for a fenced off church. That's Ashford Abbey."
Accept: "Thanks for the suggestion."
Decline: "I'll go my own way, thanks."
Ask: "Brother Mhenlo can be found in Ashford Abbey. Just follow the road southwest from town. When you come across the village of Ashford, look for a gated church. That's Ashford Abbey."
Reward dialogue
Brother Mhenlo
"I will be glad to teach you. I know Healing Prayers to Dwayna and Smiting Prayers from Balthazar. You can learn both from me, and there are, of course, trainers who can teach you other skills."

warrior primary

Objectives
Follow the road northwest from town. Follow the signs to Green Hills County. Talk to Warmaster Grast.
Reward
250 Experience

Requirements.text:
Requirements
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
warrior primary
Character in pre-Searing
Further Adventures completed

Objectives.text:
Objectives
Follow the road northwest from town. Follow the signs to Green Hills County. Talk to Warmaster Grast.

Walkthrough.text:
Walkthrough
Head northwest along the road from Haversdan and follow the road to Green Hills County. Warmaster Grast is standing near where you entered, before the large statue of Balthazar.

Dialogue.text:
Dialogue
Initial dialogue
Haversdan
"If you wish to advance your skills as a Warrior, you should study under Warmaster Grast in Green Hills County. If you follow the road northwest from town and pay attention to the signs, you shouldn't have any trouble finding Green Hills County. Grast will be near the statue of Balthazar."
Accept: "Thanks for the suggestion."
Decline: "I'll go my own way. thanks."
Ask: "Warmaster Grast will be by the statue of Balthazar in Green Hills County. Just follow the road northwest and the signs will direct you to Green Hills County."
Reward dialogue
Warmaster Grast
"Hmph. Well, you passed the first Warrior's test, but that's not exactly a great measure of your skills, is it? I'll be teaching you a few more advanced techniques and then you might want to go see if you can find trainers who can teach you other skills."

Quest_information.text:
Quest information
Haversdan will direct you to your next profession trainer, Master Ranger Nente, who is located in Regent Valley.
Requirements
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
ranger primary
Character in pre-Searing
Further Adventures completed
Objectives
Follow the road southwest from town. Turn south on the bridge near the village and enter Regent Valley. Talk to Master Ranger Nente.
Reward
250 Experience

Requirements.text:
Requirements
Tyrian (Prophecies) character
ranger primary
Character in pre-Searing
Further Adventures completed

Objectives.text:
Objectives
Follow the road southwest from town. Turn south on the bridge near the village and enter Regent Valley. Talk to Master Ranger Nente.

Walkthrough.text:
Walkthrough
It will take a while to reach Master Ranger Nente's location, but the path is not hard to follow or travel. From Haversdan, follow the road southwest along the river. Before the bridge to Ashford Village, turn south and follow the signs into Regent Valley (which is another explorable area). Continue south along the road past non-hostile Devourers to find Master Ranger Nente on a small rise.

Dialogue.text:
Dialogue
Initial dialogue
Haversdan
"Becoming a good Ranger requires extensive training in a number of different skill techniques. To begin the learning process, seek out Master Ranger Nente in Regent Valley. If you follow the road southwest from town and pay attention to the signs, you shouldn't have any trouble finding Regent Valley. Master Ranger Nente will be along the road."
Accept: "Thanks for the suggestion."
Decline: "I'll go my own way, thanks."
Ask: "Master Ranger Nente will be along the road in Regent Valley. Just follow the road southwest from town, and the signs will direct you to Regent Valley."
Reward dialogue
Master Ranger Nente
"If you're serious about your studies, I can teach you the basics of Beast Mastery. The care of an animal companion is one of the most valuable skills a Ranger can develop. After you have learned something of this, you may wish to seek out other trainers to learn new skills."
